answer.origin: Finance.yahoo.com, in an article published 2026-07-01, reporting an NN, Inc. announcement said to have occurred in late June 2026; the announcement’s exact date and underlying release are not provided.
answer.note: The report says NN plans to add 47 machine centers at its Wuxi plant for liquid cooling production for NVIDIA AI data center racks, and that all of the new capacity was already pre-sold under multi-year, multi-product awards. It also reports NN’s target of US$80–US$90 million of accretive new business in 2026. For NVDA, this is a relevant supplier-capacity and potential demand signal: it suggests capacity intended for NVIDIA-rack cooling products has been allocated and that NN expects related business in 2026. It does not establish that NVIDIA is the direct customer, identify the award counterparties, or show NVIDIA’s order value or purchase commitment. The 2026 target is NN’s target, not an estimate of NVIDIA revenue or spending.
limitations: The report does not identify the counterparties to the multi-year awards or establish whether NVIDIA is a direct customer or is served through another supplier.
It gives no contract values, NVIDIA-attributable share, shipment schedule, or evidence of deliveries, limiting what can be concluded about the scale and timing of NVDA-related demand.
The underlying NN announcement is not included, so its exact date and wording cannot be checked against this report.
follow_up: Locate NN’s late-June 2026 announcement and any related filing to verify the 47-machine-center expansion, pre-sold-capacity statement, and 2026 business target.
Check NN disclosures for the award counterparties, customer relationship, expected production and shipment timing, and any disclosed revenue attributable to the programs.
Review NVIDIA disclosures and relevant supplier announcements for confirmation of the supply-chain relationship and any stated order or deployment timing.
